blocking_finding_resolutions.resolution: A new reversible migration replaces evidence-independent document/chunk uniqueness with evidence-scoped identities. Offline processor/embedder/V2 row mapping proves distinct dataset, retrieval, and effective observations satisfy every primary/unique identity without collision.

contract_diff: Accepted migrations 001-003 remain immutable; revision 2 is expressed only as ordered migration 004.

alpha_documents_v2_document_identity is replaced by alpha_documents_v2_document_evidence_chunk_identity, which includes canonical source/content/document semantics plus document/evidence/dataset/chunk/embedding identity.
alpha_documents_v2_evidence_identity is replaced by alpha_documents_v2_evidence_chunk_identity so one immutable evidence observation may retain multiple chunks.
chunk_id remains the primary key and V2 adapter conflict target.

Rollback preflights revision-1 collisions and fails closed without deleting or rewriting evidence.
